questions: What is a script?
If the script changes, do the words change too?
What is tone?
If the tone rises, does the meaning change?
What is case?
If the case changes, does who did what change?
What is mood?
If the mood changes, does the action become less certain?
What is a standard?
If the standard changes, do earlier forms become wrong?
What is a person?
If the person changes, does the speaker have to change?
What is borrowing?
If the borrowing ends, does it all go away?
What is a marker?
If the marker is missing, can the message still be understood?
What is a channel?
If the channel changes, does the message still arrive?
What is a code?
If the code changes, can the same message still get through?
What is an attachment?
If the attachment moves, does the meaning move with it?
What is an ellipsis?
If the ellipsis is removed, is anything actually missing?
What is an article?
If the article is missing, can you still tell which one is meant?
What is a form?
If the form changes, does the meaning change too?
What is a translation?
If the translation is reversed, does it end up back where it started?
